entrypoint.do: if (($env.BAYT_LOCAL_MOCK_AI? | default '1') == '0') { if (which sd-server | is-empty) { error make { msg: 'sd-server not found on PATH' } }; ^sd-server --listen-ip 127.0.0.1 --listen-port ($env.PORT? | default '8000') -m models/sd-turbo-q8_0.gguf --cfg-scale 1.0 --steps 2 -W 256 -H 256 } else { let f = (($env.BAYT_LOCAL_WORK_DIR? | default $nu.temp-dir) | path join 'diffusion-mock.ts'); open --raw .bayt/Dockerfile.diffusion | lines | skip until {|l| $l =~ '^COPY <<.EOF. /srv/diffusion.ts$' } | skip 1 | take until {|l| $l == 'EOF' } | str join (char nl) | save -f $f; with-env { HOST: '127.0.0.1' } { ^deno run --allow-net --allow-env $f } }
